summary: Comprehensive frontend QA of JMA (Jelly of the Month Club Music Academy). 4-phase changes verified: global renames (Stew Kazoo / Beat Lab / Jam Hall / Rhythm Arcade / Ear Quest / Fun Facts Clubhouse), Academy Campus home with 6 destination rooms, RoomCharacters with outfit cycling + speech bubbles on every game page, Academy Rank badge + RankBadge on Home & Sticker Book, harp Home button across all pages, and HTML title. 22/24 acceptance criteria pass. Two real bugs found: (1) Fun Facts modal does NOT open when tapping the new Stew character because musicFacts.js has no 'Stew' key (only 'Lou & Stew'); (2) The Fun Facts mobile horizontal scroller is effectively NOT wider than viewport at 390px because minWidth: 'min(720px, 95vw)' resolves to the smaller value (~370px) — the design intent of a panable scene is broken.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the NEW 'Stew' character (data-testid='funfacts-character-stew') does nothing - the fact modal never opens. Root cause: musicFacts.js has only 'Lou & Stew' key, no 'Stew' key. getRandomFact('Stew') returns null, so setActiveFact() is never called. Verified: tapping 'Chunk' opens modal correctly; tapping 'Stew' does not.

Mobile horizontal-scroll design is broken. The scene wrapper uses minWidth: 'min(720px, 95vw)'. At 390px viewport this evaluates to ~370px which is smaller than the viewport, so the scene is NOT wider than the viewport (measured scrollWidth=371 vs clientWidth=366, diff only 5px). Kids cannot meaningfully pan/explore to discover characters as described in the requirements. Likely fix: use max(720px, 95vw) or a fixed mobile width like 720px so the scene is genuinely wider than mobile viewport.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Add a 'Stew' entry to /app/frontend/src/data/musicFacts.js with 3-6 facts so the new character's tap opens the fact modal. Or alternatively, change SCENE_CHARS in FunFactsPage so the Stew button calls showFact('Lou & Stew') / shares the Lou & Stew facts (but then stickerId/character-attribution should be reviewed).

FIX (MEDIUM): Update Fun Facts scene minWidth in /app/frontend/src/pages/FunFactsPage.js. Replace 'min(720px, 95vw)' with something that is GENUINELY wider than a 390px mobile viewport, e.g. minWidth: '720px' (or 'max(720px, 100%)'), so kids can horizontally pan to discover characters as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: FunFactsPage SCENE_CHARS has two characters mapped to the same stickerId 'char_loustew' (Lou & Stew + the new Stew). Tapping Stew calls earnSticker('char_loustew') but getRandomFact('Stew') is null — inconsistent. Either give Stew its own data + sticker or alias Stew to 'Lou & Stew' facts.
HomePage.js destination 'fun-facts-clubhouse' sign label says 'CLUBHOUSE' while every other sign matches the room title — minor inconsistency.

RoomCharacters: 'transition' uses Math.random() in animation duration which produces a different value on every render; consider freezing per-character or via useMemo to avoid re-render-induced animation flicker.
One React warning is emitted: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' - benign but worth tracking down (likely a character image with missing src in a fallback path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1-4 changes confirmed except 2 Fun Facts issues. The Stew character tap-to-fact bug is the only HIGH priority item: musicFacts.js needs a 'Stew' key. The mobile horizontal-scroll for funfacts-scene-scroller needs minWidth change so scrollWidth > clientWidth meaningfully. All other rooms, navigation, RoomCharacters (outfit cycling + bubbles), RankBadge, harp Home button, renames and HTML title are verified working. 0 red console errors observed across all routes.
rca of the issue: FunFacts Stew modal bug: SCENE_CHARS in FunFactsPage.js includes a 'Stew' entry (line 28-29) but data/musicFacts.js (line 90 grep showed only 'Lou & Stew' key, no 'Stew' key). FunFactsPage.showFact() calls getRandomFact(characterName) — when name='Stew' the lookup misses and returns falsy, so setActiveFact() is never invoked and the modal stays closed. Fix is to add a 'Stew' entry in musicFacts.js (e.g. duplicate of 'Lou & Stew' or new facts). Mobile scroller bug: 'min(720px, 95vw)' returns the smaller operand. At viewport 390px, 95vw=370.5px < 720px so minWidth becomes 370.5px, defeating horizontal pan. Replace with max(720px, 95vw) or fixed 720px.
